text:
maria: claiming maintenance slot ms-841 for tenant-range schema change. target start 22:00 UTC. plan is staggered shard apply + small backfill batches. pinning runtime to v2.14.1 for the window.

deploybot: maintenance slot ms-841 acknowledged. start=2025-11-03T22:00:00Z window=45m owner=@maria holdpoint=canary_timeout=15m

sam-ops: quick checklist: canary on two smallest shards, backfill rate 1k/s, db-conn limit 120, eviction policy=soft until 30s lag then hard-evict long queries.

anya: proposed fast-rollback flow? if we see sustained >60s replication lag we need an immediate revert path.

luis: rollback playbook (short):
```
- stop backfill: `./tools/backfillctl stop --window ms-841`
- disable new writes to migrating table: `featureflag set tenant_mig_write_block true`
- unpin runtime: `infra pin-service --service api --version v2.13.9`
- promote read-only fallback model: route policy set to fallback-tier
- monitor: latency & replication for 10m
```

maria: I'll create the release note snippet and include the exact commands. also adding a deploybot holdpoint at "canary-done" so ops can gate.

deploybot: holdpoint created: ms-841.canary-done. autopause set at 15m without explicit resume. Approve to continue with full wave by reacting with :thumbsup:.

sam-ops: tagging monitoring playbooks: paging thresholds -> error budget 5% for 10m, alert if backfill errors > 0.5% in canary.

anya: also add a guard: if any table-level locks > 5s across >3 replicas then abort. we had deadlocks last time.

luis: added sample commands to ops runbook for quick revert: `psql -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ~ 'long_backfill' AND state='active' AND now()-query_start > interval '30 seconds'"`

maria: canary windows scheduled at T+0 and T+15m, I'll post final release notes and pinning line to #release-notes later.

deploybot: canary wave complete by @maria. status=ok, errors=0.12% latency+3ms. next action: CONTINUE or ABORT.

sam-ops: observed a small spike on shard-7 replication lag = 42s, within tolerance. continue from my side.

anya: +1 to continue but keep holdpoint active. if lag crosses 55s auto-abort.

luis: starting staggered full-wave now. I'll run backfill with `--rate 1000` and watch the eviction queue.

maria: on it. I'll toggle the canary flag and unpin the canary after 10m. will post short summary to #oncall if anything changes.

deploybot: full-wave started. window=ms-841 wave=1/3 queued=12 backfill-workers=8

sam-ops: note: if we need to abort mid-wave follow the rollback playbook above and set `ff tenant_mig_write_block true` before unpin to avoid split-brain.

anya: thanks — adding a final rescue step to ops doc: if unpin fails, promote fallback routing and scale up read replicas for 5m.

maria: closing thread with deploybot: keep the eviction threshold log at INFO and capture `pg_locks` snapshot every 30s for postmortem. will share post-run artifacts. :white_check_mark:
